<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.4.3 -->

## What's Changed
* Name the receiver, not the unseen ancestor, in the unconfirmed-member hint by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/122
* Let a host swap the workspace's server or style by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/123
* Release 0.4.3 by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/124


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/compare/v0.4.2...v0.4.3

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.4.2 -->

## What's Changed
* Push the formula straight to the tap by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/110
* Keep one IRIS session per connection, and end it by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/113
* Report NEW in a procedure block as an error by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/111
* Move the diagnostic tests to the corpus by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/115
* Drop three tests that only exercised a mocked IRIS by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/116
* Follow IRIS on NEW of parameters, method-body defines and the implicit includes by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/117
* Assume nothing about a nested label's returns, and refuse $$ on a label without a formal list by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/118
* Look members up by namespace, typed by what the namespace holds by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/114
* Follow the corpus: arities, severities, empty subscripts, Goto targets by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/120
* Resolve the implicit class includes once, and parse each IRIS include once by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/121
* Release 0.4.2 by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/119


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/compare/v0.4.1...v0.4.2

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.4.1 -->

## What's Changed
* Run CI before releasing by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/104
* Document installing from Homebrew by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/105
* Ask for the operating system in a bug report by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/106
* Check a macro call's argument count against its definition by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/107
* Catch more of what IRIS refuses to compile by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/108


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/compare/v0.4.0...v0.4.1

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.4.0 -->

## What's Changed
* Document Windows build prerequisites and point to the IRIS options by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/93
* Give the host a high-level and a low-level interface to IRIS by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/92
* Resolve members through one lookup, in IRIS's order by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/96
* Default `ascot declare` to ~/.ascot and record the IRIS version by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/94
* Trust the OS's certificate store by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/99
* Carry a class's Inheritance keyword through IRIS's class info by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/100
* Open a Homebrew tap PR on release by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/91
* Resolve IRIS classes like workspace classes by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/97
* Install ascot on Linux through the Homebrew tap too by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/102
* Mask the optional arguments IRIS's dictionary leaves without defaults by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/103
* Release 0.4.0 by @isc-klu in https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/pull/101


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/intersystems-community/ascot/compare/v0.3.1...v0.4.0
